thread_text:
Alex K: Heads-up — onboarding for model orca-2-8k-v2 hitting two separate issues in staging: tokenizer producing unexpected token counts (garbled outputs) and OOM during model init with 4GB shard settings. Can we triage? :eyes:
Priya R: Thanks. Can you paste the weights location and the exact onboarding config you used? Also which tokenizer variant (HF fast/slow)?
Alex K: Weights: s3://redwood-models/onboarding/orca-2-8k-v2/sha256-abc123
Alex K: Config snippet:
```yaml
model_name: orca-2-8k-v2
tokenizer: open_orca/orca-2-8k-tokenizer
dtype: float16
shard_size_gb: 4
load_in_8bit: false
kv_cache_max_size_gb: 3
use_fast_tokenizer: true
```
Samir: I pulled staging logs — OOM trace during KV cache alloc: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 1073741824 bytes`. Lowering batch to 1 didn't help. Could be dtype/quant mismatch or bad allocation accounting with our shard layout.
Maria D: Also seeing weird tokenization diffs: prompt "Explain Newton's laws" tokenized to 27 tokens here vs 22 in HF ref -> leads to truncated context and bad completion.
Zheng L: Common root cause is fast vs slow tokenizer and special-token mapping. Try `use_fast_tokenizer: false` or explicitly set `bos_token`, `eos_token`, `pad_token` in the model config. Also run:
```
python tools/tokenizer_diff.py --model-s3 s3://redwood-models/onboarding/orca-2-8k-v2/ --ref huggingface/orca-2-8k
```
to get a vocab/token mapping diff.
Priya R: OpsBot, any infra changes in staging?
OpsBot: deploy-bot: cuda-driver 535.86 rolled to staging hosts at 2024-08-02T03:42Z; no kernel or docker runtime changes reported.
Samir: I tried `use_fast_tokenizer: false` and set `kv_cache_max_size_gb: 2`, enabled cpu offload for KV (offload: true) — model loads further but still OOM at attention init. Next steps: increase shards from 4 -> 8 or enable KV swapping to CPU earlier in init.
Alex K: For short-term mitigation, can we fallback to orca-1-8k variant in prod until onboarding stabilizes? Also we should add a config validation step to reject inconsistent dtype/quant/tokenizer combos before onboarding.
Priya R: Samir — can you open a tiny PR that 1) runs `rwdl-validate-model-config` in onboarding pipeline preflight, and 2) applies a safe tokenizer mapping if token counts mismatch? Tag me for review.
Samir: Will do. PR WIP; will include a unit test that compares token counts across a small prompt set.
Maria D: I'll gather failing prompts and expected token counts and upload them: https://company.share/fail-cases/orca2
Zheng L: Also recommend CI check for tokenizers package version (pin to >=0.13.2) and an explicit vocab size check to fail onboarding early.
Alex K: Timeline? If PR lands today we can canary to staging tomorrow. If canary fails, fallback to orca-1 in prod and block further onboardings. I'll post status to #eng-oncall when canary starts.
Priya R: Small doc ask — update docs/onboarding/models.md with the preflight step and exact S3 path.
Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2427 — adds validation + tokenizer mapping. :thumbsup:
Alex K: I'll run tokenizer diff now and paste logs here.
Alex K: (later) tokenizer diff shows vocab size mismatch: staging vocab 50260 vs hf_ref 50264 — 4 tokens missing. That explains the off-by-4 shift and truncation. Posting full diff in the PR.
Maria D: That delta matches the failing prompts. Good catch.
Zheng L: After PR merges, recommend re-run onboarding with `shard_size_gb: 2` and `offload: true` to minimize OOM risk during init.
Alex K: OK closing loop for now. Will update thread when canary completes. Thanks everyone.
